review_notes: I read the whole file. It contains only positivity and inequality theorems about constants. It declares no definitions, structures or abbreviations, so it adds no competing concept of its own. The one concept-level overlap is `conjugateExponent`, which wraps `Real.conjExponent` in `LeanPool/ParameterFreeGradient/O3/Geometry.lean` (`noncomputable def conjugateExponent (p : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.conjExponent p`). That definition lives in a different file and is a named alias, not an independent version, so it falls outside this file and this rubric. This file only uses it, in `conjugate_pos`. The `above*` constants are defined in `AboveTwoStatements.lean` and are specific to this development. I found no Mathlib counterparts and did not search for any. Standalone theorem duplication is excluded by the rubric. The remaining uncertainty is whether Mathlib has a bundled concept equivalent to these constants. That seems unlikely given how specific they are.
